# FilterRuleBuilder

```ts
import { FilterRuleBuilder } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Condition filters for a table (Figma hellopc.table.filter.rule.builder, node 18224:820), in a dialog-style popover: "Show rows that match All rules / Any rule", one row per rule, Add rule, and Clear / Apply. Use it for conditions — "Device name contains PF4", "Status is not Offline". For picking values from a short list, use the Filter Menu.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scope` | `'column' \| 'advanced'` | `'advanced'` | column — opened from a column header; the field is fixed to field (400px). advanced — opened from the Filter Bar; each rule picks its field (600px). |
| `fields` | `DropdownOption[]` | — | Selectable fields (advanced) — also used to name the fixed field in column scope. |
| `field` | `string` | — | The fixed field in column scope. |
| `operators` | `DropdownOption[]` | **required** | Operators offered for every rule. |
| `title` | `string` | `'Advanced filters' / `Filter by ${field label}`` | Panel heading. |
| `value` | `FilterRuleSet` | — | Controlled applied rule set. |
| `defaultValue` | `FilterRuleSet` | `{ match: 'all', rules: [] }` | Uncontrolled initial applied rule set. |
| `onApply` | `(value: FilterRuleSet) => void` | — | Fires with the applied rule set on Apply (rules without a value are dropped). |
| `open` | `boolean` | — | Controlled open state. |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` | — | Fires when the panel opens or closes. |
| `triggerAppearance` | `FilterTriggerAppearance \| 'icon'` | `'link' (advanced) / 'icon' (column)` | Trigger look: link — primary ghost "Advanced filters" with a rule Counter (Filter Bar full); filter — outline/tonal "Filters" pill with a counter (Filter Bar compact); icon — an xs IconButton for a column header. |
| `triggerLabel` | `string` | `'Advanced filters' / `Filter ${field label}`` | Trigger text (or the icon button's accessible name). |


## Usage

```tsx
<FilterRuleBuilder fields={fields} operators={operators} onApply={setRules} />
<FilterRuleBuilder scope="column" field="status" fields={fields} operators={operators} />
<FilterRuleBuilder fields={fields} operators={operators} value={rules} onApply={setRules} />
<FilterRuleBuilder fields={fields} operators={operators} triggerAppearance="filter" triggerLabel="Filters" />
<FilterRuleBuilder fields={fields} operators={operators} title="Filter devices" />
```

## Accessibility

- The trigger carries aria-haspopup="dialog" / aria-expanded; the panel is a dialog named by its title. Focus moves into it on open, Esc closes (an open select closes first), and focus returns to the trigger.
- Every control in a rule row is labelled by position — "Field for rule 2", "Operator for rule 2", "Value for rule 2", "Remove rule 2" — since the row has no visible labels. Removing a rule moves focus to "Add rule".
- The column-header trigger's name includes the active count ("Filter Status, 1 active").

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use scope="column" from a header, advanced from the Filter Bar | Show a field picker when the column already fixes the field |
| Apply once on Apply, then show the count on the trigger | Re-query on every keystroke in the value field |
| Offer operators that fit the field's data | Offer "Contains" on a date or a status |
| Use the Filter Menu for a short list of known values | Make people type values they could tick |
